posts.linkedin:
I check the listing, the phone, the website, and the mail, and I still feel unsure.

My name is Anmol Rattan. I run AR Designs from Himachal Pradesh, and I built a lead finder that finds local businesses on Google Maps and checks that they are real.

Before I message anyone, I check that the listing is open, the phone number works, the website is live, and the email domain receives mail.

I do this because I do not want to waste time on leads that are not real. Still, I wonder if there are checks I have not thought of.

I have spoken with agency owners and many businesses, and everyone seems to do it differently.

What other checks do you trust when you verify a lead before messaging it?
posts.bluesky: Many small businesses repeat rates on WhatsApp. A mobile‑first website with a pricing page and a WhatsApp button can reduce that. DM SITE for a quick look at your website – I’ll point out 3 things to fix. Pay after approval. #SmallBusinessIndia #WebsiteTips

replies.if_they_say: How much does a website cost?
replies.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out. I build fast, mobile‑first sites with a WhatsApp button and clear pricing. What main action do you want visitors to take – call, WhatsApp, or a booking form? A basic site starts at INR 1,499, up to INR 3,599 for a bundle, and you pay only after you approve the work.

replies.if_they_say: Do you do this for my salon?
replies.reply: Hi, thanks for the message. I create simple mobile‑first websites that show services, rates and a one‑tap WhatsApp button, which works for any small business like salons, cafes, or gyms. What’s the biggest info you currently repeat on WhatsApp?

replies.if_they_say: Can you fix my existing site?
replies.reply: Hi, thanks for contacting me. I can improve an existing site by adding a pricing page, consistent service copy, and a clear contact button. What’s the main issue you’re facing right now – missing rates, unclear services, or no contact button?
